_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (5/73 windows ±2) plus fear/greed 51 and flat 30d momentum keep the score inside 47-54 through the live post-FOMC and opex window unless a volatility breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit forward is HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase call (metals-flow story only) — partial split, lean analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear/greed and 30d momentum stay inside 47-54 and BTC remains range-bound through opex and the FOMC 72h window
next_move.invalidated_if: Impulse driving composite score below 39 or above 55 with expanding DVOL and CVD leaving the low-20s
